phase: Phase 1 primitive-definition & implementation audit (causal contract selection + continuity segments)
instrument: NQ front-month; discovery=NQU6; warm-up=continuous front-month via CAUSAL prev-session volume roll

contract_selection.method: CAUSAL: contract for session S = argmax outright volume of PREVIOUS completed session S-1; frozen at S-1 close (17:00 ET). Current session never participates in its own decision.
contract_selection.bootstrap: disclosed only at data-start (2025-01-02) and post-seam (2026-07-06, prev winner NQM6 expired)
contract_selection.ledger: outputs/ledgers/roll_decisions.csv (per-session: selected, evidence session, decision timestamp, selected+competing volumes)

continuity_segments.rule: new segment after (a) contract roll, (b) seam, (c) non-calendar data gap > 60 min. Sub-60min illiquidity gaps logged, not boundaries.
continuity_segments.trailing_history: prev 10/20/40 require that many COMPLETE SAME-SEGMENT predecessors; else null. Warm-up is NOT a predecessor of July across the seam.

seam.note: Warm-up ends on NQM6; discovery is NQU6. The seam is a new continuity segment (contract change + ~28-day gap). Trailing 10/20/40 statistics require that many completed candles FROM THE DISCOVERY SEGMENT; warm-up observations are NOT used as immediate predecessors of July. Older observations existing does NOT make daily/4h histories available in July.

warmup_requirement.note: Older observations exist (>=40 sessions) but are in prior segments; per-segment continuity means daily prev10/20/40 and 4h prev40 remain UNAVAILABLE (null) throughout the July week.

timezone_rules.daily_candle_span: 18:00 ET -> 16:59 ET (full 1380 tradeable minutes; 17:00-18:00 maintenance excluded)

causality: current excluded from own trailing history
no future look-back to mark structures
trailing history same-segment complete only; warm-up never crosses the seam
no structure spans a segment/roll boundary
determinism: no randomness; no seeds; identical inputs reproduce identical outputs
reproduce_cmd: python3 run.py data.csv <discovery.zst> warmup.csv <warmup.zst> && python3 charts.py && python3 tests.py
